name: Sergio Mantovani
features: olive skin, dark hair parted at the side, dark eyes, round open face, medium build, affable steady expression
bio: A Maserati man for the whole of his short career, with two fifth places in 1954 and thirds at Syracuse and Rome the same year. Practising for the 1955 Valentino Grand Prix at Turin he crashed and lost a leg, which ended his driving at twenty-five; he spent the rest of his life on the Italian sporting commission, on the other side of the pit wall.
